summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`), a backend crypto/security phase adding IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust (`crates/fuse`, `crates/core`) and SDK layers.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves, VALIDATION.md + PATTERNS.md written, plan checker passed 0 blockers), and Wave 1 execution was initiated with subagent 58-01 spawned; session ends mid-execution.

repo: Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) uses TDD mode, fine granularity, 4 plans across 2 waves, requirement HARD-09, and decisions D-01..D-13.
`crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client/core` (dependency cycle), so cross-language Rust test vectors must live in `crates/fuse/tests/` rather than `crates/crypto/tests/`.
9 FUSE resolve sites call IPNS resolution without signature verification; they will be routed through a new `resolve_ipns_verified` chokepoint in `crates/fuse`.
Plan 58-02 has a mandatory human checkpoint at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E gate; it requires the local stack to be running (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo).
The local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was confirmed up at plan time.
Execution branch is `feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage`; AUTO_MODE=true so GSD checkpoints auto-advance unless a plan marks a hard stop.

code.finding: The `## Open Questions` section heading must carry a `(RESOLVED)` marker or the plan checker flags it as a warning, even if all questions are substantively addressed in-plan.
VALIDATION.md frontmatter is filled by the orchestrator; body scaffold is owned by execute/validate tooling — do not pre-fill the body.

workflow: The GSD commit helper can report `commit_failed` as a false negative; always verify with `git log` rather than retrying the commit.
For delicate security/crypto phases, sequential execution on the feature branch is preferable to parallel worktree execution to avoid cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
A plan checker cosmetic warning (doc heading style) is cheaper to fix directly in the artifact than to trigger a full planner revision cycle.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` section should have inline resolution markers added before plan checker runs to avoid spurious warnings.

friction: `commit_failed` false negative from the GSD commit helper required an extra `git log` verification step to confirm the commit actually landed.
Plan checker flagged RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` heading for missing `(RESOLVED)` marker — a cosmetic issue that still required a manual edit + re-commit.
Dependency cycle between `crates/crypto` and `crates/fuse`/`api-client` forced test placement in a non-obvious location (`crates/fuse/tests/` instead of `crates/crypto/tests/`).
